content.text: I've read the release and the brief line by line. Here is my check.

facts.evidence: Total sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 reached $47.9 billion, an increase of $2.6 billion, or 5.7%, compared to the second quarter of fiscal 2025.
Net earnings for the quarter were $4.8 billion, or $4.79 per diluted share, compared with net earnings of $4.6 billion, or $4.58 per diluted share, in the same period of fiscal 2025.
Adjusted(1) diluted earnings per share for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $4.92, compared with adjusted diluted earnings per share of $4.68 in the same period of fiscal 2025.

Comparable sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 increased 1.7%, driven by a 1.3% increase in comparable sales in the U.S. (both figures correct; the causal 'driven by' framing is not in the release)
The company reaffirms its fiscal 2026 guidance... Fiscal 2026 guidance projects total sales growth of approximately 2.5% to 4.5%
Comparable customer transactions decreased 1.0% for the quarter, while comparable average ticket increased 2.8%.
The company reaffirms its fiscal 2026 guidance, which includes IEEPA tariff refunds expected to partially offset unplanned fuel, energy, and other product input costs throughout the fiscal year.

claims.claim: Total sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $47.9 billion, an increase of $2.6 billion, or 5.7%, compared to the second quarter of fiscal 2025.
Net earnings for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $4.8 billion, or $4.79 per diluted share.
Net earnings in the second quarter of fiscal 2025 were $4.6 billion, or $4.58 per diluted share.
Adjusted (non-GAAP) diluted earnings per share for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $4.92, compared with $4.68 in the same period of fiscal 2025.
Comparable sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 increased 1.7%.
Comparable sales in the U.S. increased 1.3% in the second quarter of fiscal 2026.
The 1.7% total comparable sales increase was driven by the 1.3% increase in U.S. comparable sales.
claims.note: The release lists the two figures side by side without attributing total comp growth to the U.S.; U.S. comps (1.3%) were below total comps (1.7%), so the causal framing is not supported.

claims.claim: The company saw broad-based demand across the business, with customers continuing to engage in smaller projects during the quarter.
Comparable customer transactions decreased 1.0% in the second quarter of fiscal 2026.
Comparable average ticket increased 2.8% in the second quarter of fiscal 2026.
Operating income for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 was $6.8 billion, compared with $6.6 billion in the same period of fiscal 2025.
The company reaffirms its fiscal 2026 guidance.
Fiscal 2026 guidance includes IEEPA tariff refunds, expected to partially offset unplanned fuel, energy, and other product input costs throughout the fiscal year.
Fiscal 2026 guidance projects total sales growth of approximately 2.5% to 4.5%.
Fiscal 2026 guidance projects comparable sales growth of approximately flat to 2.0%.
Fiscal 2026 guidance includes gross margin of approximately 33.1%.
Fiscal 2026 guidance includes operating margin of approximately 12.4% to 12.6%.
Fiscal 2026 guidance includes adjusted (non-GAAP) diluted earnings per share growing approximately flat to 4.0% from $14.69 in fiscal 2025.

At the end of the second quarter the company operated 2,364 retail stores and over 1,340 SRS locations across all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, Guam, 10 Canadian provinces and Mexico.
Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the second quarter were $2.1 billion, compared with $2.8 billion at the end of the second quarter of fiscal 2025.
Total stockholders' equity at the end of the second quarter was $16.6 billion, compared with $10.7 billion at the end of the second quarter of fiscal 2025.

The company reports adjusted operating margin guidance of approximately 12.8% to 13.0% for fiscal 2026, excluding an expected approximately 40 basis point impact from acquired intangible asset amortization.
Adjusted operating income, adjusted operating margin, and adjusted diluted earnings per share are non-GAAP financial measures, with results otherwise reported in accordance with U.S. GAAP.
